# acecloud_lb_listener (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud Load Balancer Listener.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `loadbalancer_id` (String) ID of the load balancer this listener belongs to.
- `name` (String) Name of the listener. Changing this forces recreation.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol for the listener (HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, TERMINATED_HTTPS).
- `protocol_port` (Number) Port number for the listener (1-65535). Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the listener was created.
- `default_pool_id` (String) ID of the default pool for this listener.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the listener.
- `operating_status` (String) Operating status (e.g. ONLINE, OFFLINE).
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status (e.g. ACTIVE, PENDING_CREATE).
